THE DESTINATION

About Yulla Kanda

Yulla Kanda is a breathtaking high-altitude temple located in the Kinnaur district of Himachal Pradesh, sitting at around 3,895 metres above sea level. Known as one of the highest Krishna temples in the world, it is uniquely situated in the middle of an alpine lake, creating a surreal reflection of the surrounding Himalayan peaks.

Reaching this hidden gem requires a moderate to difficult trek of around 12 km from Yulla village, making the journey as rewarding as the destination itself. Unlike crowded tourist spots, Yulla Kanda offers a peaceful and untouched experience — perfect for travellers seeking raw nature, spirituality, and solitude. The best time to visit is between May and October.

REASONS TO GO

Why Visit Yulla Kanda

Unique temple location — a rare Krishna temple built right in the middle of a lake, giving the place a mystical, almost unreal feel.

Stunning reflections — the calm alpine lake acts like a mirror, perfectly reflecting the surrounding Himalayan peaks.

Offbeat destination — still hidden and less explored, so you experience raw nature without heavy crowds.

Adventurous trek — 12 km from Yulla village through forests, meadows, and mountain trails.

A content goldmine — cinematic landscapes and unique temple visuals, perfect for photography.

Peace & solitude — no commercialisation around, just complete silence and calm.

A spiritual experience — the Krishna temple in such a serene setting adds a deep spiritual vibe.

Unmatched natural beauty — alpine meadows, snow-capped peaks, and open skies in their rawest form.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

Tap a day to see the full plan.

  • Distance: Approximately 550 km. Travel time: 12–15 hours.
  • Assembly: Assemble at Akshardham Metro Station by 7:00 PM.
  • Departure: Departure from Delhi at 7:30 PM by AC Traveller.
  • Overnight journey: Approximately 550 km (13–14 hours) towards Yulla Khas in the Kinnaur region.
  • En route: Short breaks for dinner and refreshments.
  • Arrival: Arrive in Yulla Khas by afternoon.
  • Check-in: Check-in at the hotel/homestay and freshen up after the long journey.
  • Acclimatize: Rest and acclimatize to the mountain altitude.
  • Evening walk: A short local walk around Yulla Khas village.
  • Overnight stay: Homestay in Yulla Khas.
  • Breakfast: Wake up early and have breakfast at the hotel/homestay.
  • Trek begins: Approximately 14–15 km in total, through forest trails and open meadows.
  • Arrival: Reach Yulla Kanda Lake — location of the Krishna Temple.
  • At the lake: Spend some peaceful time at the lake and temple area.
  • Overnight stay: In tents under the open sky, near the lake.
  • Sunrise: Wake up early to witness the sunrise over the mountains.
  • Trek down: Approximately 10 km back to Yulla Village.
  • Rest: Reach Yulla Khas, freshen up, and rest.
  • Departure: Depart for Delhi by afternoon in an AC Traveller/Bus.
  • Arrival: Overnight journey — reach Delhi the next morning.

Inclusions & Exclusions

Not included in your package

  • Tips for guides / drivers
  • 5% GST, as applicable
